summary: First testing run for SMART BUY. Ran pytest against real SerpAPI + Gemini backend (12 tests, 11 passed) and Playwright UI walkthrough of Home/Search/Product/Compare/Recommend. Backend correctly enforces zero-fake-data mandate (400 for short query, 404 for missing product, honest source_unavailable=true on refresh-reviews, insufficient=true on analyze-reviews with 0 reviews, INR currency, source='serpapi_google_shopping'). Gemini calls (compare + recommend) return structured JSON verdicts and grounded recommendations. Frontend renders 40 real product cards for 'iphone 15' with ₹ prices, provenance badges, and functional compare/verdict/recommend flows. All data-testids present.

minor.issue: In preview environment, product already had >=3 price observations recorded across prior runs, so deal became 'Great Deal' instead of 'Insufficient history'. This is CORRECT behavior per compute_deal_label logic (>=3 real observations flips label). Not a bug — only note is that MongoDB was NOT empty at start of this run (contrary to the review request's note). If a fresh-DB assumption is required for tests, add a cleanup script or run against clean DB.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: on backend startup or via a dev-only endpoint, allow clearing db.price_observations/db.products for a clean deal-detection state during automated tests.

Optional UI: On Recommend page, ensure the candidate list is rendered with data-testid^='product-card-' (or 'candidate-card-') so automated tests can verify count directly. Currently the recommendation panel renders correctly but candidate-card testid was not detected in 90s wait.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 616 lines — approaching split threshold; consider splitting into routers (search, product, ai) for maintainability.
call_gemini_json catches all Exception and re-raises 502; consider distinguishing timeout vs auth vs parse errors.

record_price_observation dedup window is 60s + exact price match; multiple back-to-back searches across sessions still accumulate observations, which can prematurely trigger deal labels. Consider a 24h dedup window per (product_id, seller, price).
seed_data_creation: Searches were performed against real SerpAPI (queries: 'iphone 15', 'best noise cancelling headphones under 30000'). Products persisted to MongoDB automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API contract fully validated. If retesting the 'Insufficient history' deal label, DROP db.price_observations first (or use a product_id that hasn't been searched before). The refresh-reviews endpoint correctly returns 200 + source_unavailable=true (Google product endpoint deprecation is expected). Playwright verified all major flows.
rca of the issue: Only failing test (test_product_detail deal tone) is not an app bug: preview DB retained observations from prior sessions so len(prices)>=3 triggered 'Great Deal' label per compute_deal_label. On a truly empty DB, tone would be 'neutral' with label 'Insufficient history' as the code path is correct.
